query: Civiqs Trump approval daily tracker August 20 2026

results.content:
President Donald Trump’s job approval rating in Alabama remains above water, though it has declined from the high point he reached at the start of his second term, according to the latest tracking data from Civiqs.

The survey shows 53% of Alabama voters approve of Trump’s job performance, while 40% disapprove. Another 8% said they neither approve nor disapprove. [...] Here's how the president's overall approval ratings look:
